I take pictures for social media, but I also write a short diary for special events like my birthday or a graduation ceremony. This way, I can keep my memories in different ways.

I believe that choosing to write instead of taking photos offers unique psychological benefits. While photography is excellent for capturing visual evidence of an event, writing allows for a deeper level of emotional processing and reflection. In the digital age, we tend to take hundreds of photos that we rarely look back at, making memories feel somewhat fleeting. In contrast, a handwritten journal is a tangible keepsake that preserves our inner thoughts and personal growth over time. That being said, it doesn't have to be an 'either-or' situation. Most people I know in Vietnam find a balance by using photos for instant sharing and writing for more significant, private milestones.

sub_questions.question: Compare 2 pictures.

answers.text: In the first picture, I can see a construction site with many workers and big cranes. It looks very busy and noisy. In contrast, the second picture shows a man standing in a large field under a blue sky. He looks very happy and relaxed. The main difference is the environment: the first one is about hard work in the city, while the second one is about enjoying nature. I think the workers in the first photo are probably stressed, but the man in the second photo is free from work.

Both images illustrate different aspects of human life, but they stand in stark contrast to each other. While the first photo depicts a group of engineers working on a massive construction project, representing the hustle and bustle of urban development, the second one captures a moment of pure serenity in the countryside. The most striking difference is the atmosphere: one is industrial and potentially stressful, whereas the other is peaceful and rejuvenating. It's likely that the man in the field is taking a break to reconnect with nature after a long period of work, which is essential for mental well-being in today's fast-paced world.

sub_questions.question: Do you prefer to living in the city or in the suburbs? Why so?

answers.text: I prefer living in the city because it is more convenient for my life. In the city, there are many shopping malls, good hospitals, and international schools for children. It is also easier to find a high-paying job. Although the city is noisy and has a lot of traffic jams, I like the busy lifestyle here. I think the suburbs are too quiet for a young person like me, and it takes a long time to travel to the center.

Personally, I lean towards living in the suburbs rather than a hectic metropolitan area. While the city offers better career opportunities and entertainment facilities, I find the living environment there quite suffocating due to air pollution and overcrowding. In contrast, the outskirts provide a much healthier atmosphere with more green spaces, which is ideal for my mental health. Even though I have to commute a bit further to work every day, I believe the peace and tranquility of the suburbs are worth the trade-off.

sub_questions.question: How to attract more people to live in rural areas?

answers.text: In my opinion, there are several ways to attract people to the countryside. First, the government should build more schools and hospitals so that families feel safe to move there. Second, we need to create more jobs by building factories or supporting local businesses in rural areas. Finally, improving the internet connection is very important because many young people want to work online. If the countryside has good facilities like the city, I think more people will choose to live there.

To encourage more people to relocate to rural areas, a multi-faceted approach is required. The most crucial factor is infrastructure development; if the government invested more in high-speed transport links and healthcare services, the gap between urban and rural living would narrow. Additionally, offering tax incentives for companies to set up branches in the countryside would create diverse job opportunities for local residents and migrants. Lastly, promoting 'agritourism' or organic farming could appeal to the younger generation who are looking for a more sustainable and peaceful lifestyle. Once these basic needs are met, rural areas will naturally become a more attractive destination.

sub_questions.question: Tell me what do you see you from the two pictures?

answers.text: Both pictures show people with their pets. In the first picture, a woman is holding a fluffy orange cat in her kitchen. She looks very happy. In contrast, the second picture shows a young boy holding a snake in front of an aquarium. While the cat is a common pet in Vietnam, the snake is very unusual. However, it is clear that both the woman and the boy really love their animals and feel comfortable with them.

These two images present a fascinating contrast between traditional and exotic pets. On the left, we see a woman sharing a warm moment with her cat, which is a typical domestic animal that provides companionship. Conversely, the right image depicts a boy interacting with a snake, which is a much more unconventional choice of pet. Although these animals are completely different in nature, both owners seem to have a deep bond with their pets. In my opinion, this reflects how diverse people's interests can be when it comes to choosing an animal to care for at home.

sub_questions.question: How to raise these animals?

answers.text: To raise a cat, first, you need to provide healthy food and fresh water every day. It is also important to have a clean litter box and a comfortable bed. For a snake, the most important thing is a good glass tank with the right temperature. You should also feed it once a week. For both animals, you need to visit the vet if they are sick. In my opinion, raising a pet requires a lot of love and patience.

Raising these animals requires very different approaches depending on their specific needs. For a domestic cat, it’s essential to focus on a balanced diet and regular vaccinations to prevent diseases. Moreover, providing mental stimulation through toys is crucial for their well-being. On the other hand, keeping a reptile like a snake is more demanding as it requires a controlled environment. You must ensure the terrarium has the perfect humidity and heat levels to mimic its natural habitat. Regardless of the species, the key to successful pet ownership is doing thorough research and being fully committed to their long-term care.

sub_questions.question: Many people think that it should not be kept in the house, what do you think?

answers.text: I agree with this opinion, especially for wild animals like snakes or spiders. First, they can be dangerous for family members, especially children. If a snake escapes, it can bite someone. Second, it is not natural for these animals to live in a small cage. I think they are happier in the forest or the wild. However, for common pets like cats and dogs, keeping them inside is fine because they are friendly and clean. So, it depends on the type of animal.

I personally believe that this is a complex issue with valid arguments on both sides. On one hand, keeping exotic animals like reptiles indoors can pose significant safety risks and health hazards, such as the spread of bacteria. Furthermore, many people argue that it is unethical to confine wild creatures to cramped tanks, as it deprives them of their natural behaviors. On the other hand, for domesticated animals, living indoors provides them with protection and a better quality of life. In the context of Vietnam, I think we need stricter regulations on owning exotic species to protect both the owners and the environment. Ultimately, if someone chooses to keep a pet, they must ensure a suitable habitat that meets the animal's welfare.

sub_questions.question: Tell me what you see from the two pictures?

answers.text: These two pictures show two very different living spaces. In the first picture on the left, there is a man standing on a wooden staircase. The room looks quite old, dark, and traditional with a lot of brown furniture. In contrast, the second picture shows a modern room with a woman sitting at a desk. Everything is white and full of light. There is a sofa and a bicycle on the wall. While the first room feels classic, the second one feels very fresh and clean.

Both images illustrate distinct interior styles, reflecting different eras and lifestyles. The picture on the left features a classic, perhaps Victorian-style house with dark wood panels and an elegant staircase, creating a formal and somewhat nostalgic atmosphere. On the other hand, the second image depicts a contemporary, minimalist workspace. The room is bathed in natural light and decorated with modern furniture in a neutral color palette. What stands out to me is the contrast between the traditional grandeur of the first house and the functional, airy feel of the modern studio.

sub_questions.question: Where would you rather live? Why?

answers.text: Actually, I would rather live in the modern house in the second picture. The main reason is that it looks very bright and clean with many white furnitures. I am a young person, so I like a minimalist lifestyle. Also, having a workspace near the window like that would help me feel more comfortable when I study English. The first house is beautiful, but it looks a bit too dark and scary for me at night.

To be honest, I'm more inclined towards the contemporary apartment shown in the second image. As someone who lives in a hectic city like Ho Chi Minh City, I really appreciate a living space that is airy and filled with natural light, as it helps me recharge my energy after work. I’m a big fan of the minimalist interior design because it creates a sense of freedom and organization. While I admire the classic elegance and the historical vibe of the first house, I feel that a modern studio better suits my dynamic lifestyle and professional needs.

sub_questions.question: Why do people like to decorate their home?

answers.text: In my opinion, people like to decorate their homes for two reasons. First, it makes the house look more beautiful and comfortable to live in. When you have a nice room, you feel more relaxed after work. Second, decorating is a way to show your personality. For example, some people like modern styles while others like traditional things. In Vietnam, we especially love decorating our houses before the Lunar New Year to welcome luck into our lives.

From my perspective, home decoration is much more than just an aesthetic choice; it’s a form of self-expression. Firstly, a well-decorated home creates a sanctuary that reflects the owner's taste and personality, which significantly improves their mental well-being. Furthermore, it plays a crucial role in creating a welcoming atmosphere for guests. In Vietnamese culture, a carefully decorated living room is a sign of hospitality and respect toward visitors. Ultimately, by personalizing our living space, we transform a simple house into a cozy home where we truly feel a sense of belonging.

title: Tell me about a time when you changed your job or school

content.main_topic: Tell me about a time when you changed your job or school

sub_questions.question: Tell me about a time when you changed your job or school
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: A memorable time was when I transitioned from high school to university two years ago. I had to move away from my quiet hometown to live in a big city for my studies. Everything was completely new, from the large lecture halls to the independent study routine. It was a significant milestone that marked the beginning of my adulthood and personal journey.

sub_questions.question: How did you feel about the change at the time?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: At that time, I experienced a mix of deep anxiety and immense excitement. On one hand, I felt nervous about making new friends and adapting to a much faster learning pace without parental supervision. On the other hand, I felt genuinely thrilled to explore a dynamic city environment, meet diverse classmates, and experience total freedom as an independent college student.

sub_questions.question: How did the change affect your life?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: That major change affected my daily life in several positive ways. Firstly, living far away from home forced me to learn essential practical skills like cooking, budgeting money, and managing personal schedules. Secondly, overcoming early academic difficulties made me much more confident, mature, and self-reliant. It definitely helped me adapt better to unpredictable challenges in both my personal and academic life.

title: Tell me about a time when you overcame a difficulty

content.main_topic: Tell me about a time when you overcame a difficulty

sub_questions.question: Tell me about a time when you overcame a difficulty
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: A difficult experience I had was preparing for my first major English presentation at university. At first, I felt extremely nervous, lacked speaking confidence, and feared making embarrassing mistakes in front of the class. However, I practiced my script diligently in front of a mirror every evening. Eventually, I delivered my speech very smoothly and received high praise from my teacher.

sub_questions.question: What helped you overcome that difficulty?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: Two main factors helped me overcome that difficulty. Firstly, continuous daily practice and careful preparation gave me the confidence I needed to speak clearly. Secondly, my close friends offered immense emotional support and listened to my rehearsal patiently. Their encouraging words and helpful advice reduced my anxiety, allowing me to stay calm and perform at my best on presentation day.

sub_questions.question: What can people learn from difficult experiences?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: In my opinion, people can learn many valuable life lessons from facing tough challenges. First, difficult situations teach individuals patience, self-discipline, and mental resilience under pressure. Second, overcoming obstacles helps people recognize their hidden strengths and builds stronger self-confidence for the future. Finally, facing hard times allows individuals to appreciate support from family and friends, helping them mature into stronger people.

title: Tell me about the music that comes from your country

content.main_topic: Tell me about the music that comes from your country

sub_questions.question: Tell me about the music that comes from your country
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: In my country, we have many kinds of music. We have traditional music and modern pop music. Traditional music tells stories and uses instruments like flutes and drums. It sounds very beautiful, and old people really love listening to it. But we also have famous singers in pop and rap music today. Young people listen to pop music everywhere, like in coffee shops or on the street. I think the music in my country is very interesting because it has both old and new things.

sub_questions.question: How do you feel when you hear or listen to music?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: Music makes me feel very happy. When I feel sad or tired, music helps me relax. Sometimes, a good song makes me remember happy memories. I like listening to music when I do my homework or when I want to dance. To me, music is like a good friend. It always understands how I feel.

sub_questions.question: Why do some cultures produce so much music and others so little?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I think it is because of history and traditions. In some cultures, people love to sing and dance at every festival, so music is very important to them. But in other cultures, people like painting or reading books more than music. Also, some countries use music to teach history, but others just listen to music for fun. Every culture is different.

title: Tell me about your sleeping habits

content.main_topic: Tell me about your sleeping habits

sub_questions.question: Tell me about your sleeping habits
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I usually go to bed late because I like reading books or watching TV. But I try to sleep at midnight and wake up at 7 or 8 AM. I think I need about eight hours of sleep every night. On the weekends, I sleep more because I do not have to go to work or study. I like my bedroom to be dark and cold. I also listen to soft music to sleep better. Sometimes I play with my mobile phone too much before bed, and I know it is not good.

sub_questions.question: How do you feel when you don’t have enough sleep?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: When I don’t sleep enough, I feel very tired and sometimes angry. I cannot think well. Everything is very hard to do, like working or talking to people. I often drink coffee to feel better, but I still feel very tired. In the morning, I just want to be quiet and don't want to talk to anyone.

sub_questions.question: Is getting the right amount of sleep important? Why? Why not?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: Yes, I think having enough sleep is very important. It is good for your body and your brain. If you do not sleep enough, you will feel bad and you can get sick. Sleep helps us relax after a long day. So, good sleep gives you more energy to work and study well.

title: Tell me about your favorite piece of clothing

content.main_topic: Tell me about your favorite piece of clothing

sub_questions.question: Tell me about your favorite piece of clothing
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: My favorite piece of clothing is a soft hoodie. It is black, so it is easy to wear with my jeans. I have had it for a long time. It is a little old now, but it is very warm. I love wearing it on cold nights or when I just want to relax at home. Sometimes, I also wear it when I go out with my friends. The best part is a big pocket in the front. I can put some snacks in it or keep my hands warm. It is not expensive, but I really love it.

sub_questions.question: How do you feel when you wear it?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: When I wear it, I feel very relaxed and happy. It makes me feel like I can just be myself. I usually wear it when I stay at home or go out for a short time. I also feel good because I have many happy memories with this hoodie. It just gives me a comfortable and safe feeling.

sub_questions.question: Why do people dress in such different ways?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I think people wear different clothes because everyone is different. Clothes can show who you are and how you feel today. Also, people dress differently because of the weather or their culture. Some people want to look beautiful or special, but other people just want to be comfortable. I think that is very interesting.

title: Tell me about the last time you gave someone possession

content.main_topic: Tell me about the last time you gave someone possession

sub_questions.question: Tell me about the last time you gave someone possession
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I would like to tell you about the time I gave my favorite collection of English books to my younger cousin last month. He just started high school and he wanted to improve his English, but he didn't have many good materials. Those books were very special to me because I spent a lot of money and time collecting them when I was a student. At first, I felt a bit sad to see them go, but I realized that they would be much more useful to him than just sitting on my shelf. I spent an afternoon cleaning the books and writing some small notes to encourage him. When I gave him the box, he was so happy and promised to study hard. It made me feel like I did something very meaningful with my old things.

sub_questions.question: How did you feel?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I felt very happy and satisfied. Even though those books were my favorite possessions, seeing my cousin's excited face was a great reward. I realized that sharing what we have with others can bring more joy than keeping it for ourselves. It made me feel closer to my family.

sub_questions.question: How should people encourage others?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: In my opinion, the best way to encourage someone is to listen to them and give them honest praise. We should focus on their strengths instead of their mistakes. Also, giving small gifts or just saying 'I believe in you' can give people a lot of confidence to overcome their problems.

title: Tell me a time you saved up to buy something for yourself

content.main_topic: Tell me a time you saved up to buy something for yourself

sub_questions.question: Tell me a time you saved up to buy something for yourself
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I would like to tell you about the time I saved money to buy a new smartphone two years ago. At that time, I was a student and I didn't have much money, but I really needed a better phone for my studies and to take photos. I decided to save my lunch money and stop buying expensive coffee for six months. I also took a part-time job as a tutor on weekends. It was quite difficult because I had to refuse many invitations from my friends to go to the cinema or go shopping. However, I put all my extra money into a small piggy bank every day. Finally, after half a year, I had enough money to go to the store and buy the phone I wanted. It was a very great lesson for me about how to manage my money wisely.

sub_questions.question: How did you feel?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I felt extremely proud and satisfied with myself. Holding the phone that I bought with my own hard-earned money was a much better feeling than receiving it as a gift. It gave me a sense of independence and taught me that I can achieve my goals if I am patient and disciplined.

sub_questions.question: People spend too much money on unimportant things. What do you think?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I think this is true for many people today. Because of social media and advertising, people often buy things they don't really need, like expensive clothes or trendy gadgets. This can lead to financial problems. In my opinion, we should focus on buying quality things and saving money for more important goals in the future.

title: Tell me about a time when you had to work with other people

content.main_topic: Tell me about a time when you had to work with other people

sub_questions.question: Tell me about a time when you had to work with other people
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I would like to tell you about a time last semester when I had to work with three classmates on a marketing project. We had to create a business plan for a new coffee shop. At first, it was quite difficult because we all had different ideas and we couldn't agree on the logo or the price. I was the person in charge of collecting data, while my friends worked on the design and the presentation. We met every weekend at the library to discuss our progress. We learned how to listen to each other and find the best solutions together. In the end, our teacher gave us an A and praised our teamwork. It was a great experience because I realized that working together is much faster and more fun than working alone.

sub_questions.question: How do you feel about working as part of a team?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I generally enjoy working in a team because I can learn a lot of new things from my partners. It makes me feel more confident because I know that my teammates will support me if I make a mistake. However, sometimes I feel a bit stressed if some members are lazy or don't finish their work on time.

sub_questions.question: What are the characteristics of a successful team?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: In my opinion, a successful team needs good communication and clear goals. Every member should know exactly what they need to do. Also, respect is very important; we need to listen to everyone's opinions and help each other when there is a problem. A team that trusts each other will always be successful.

title: Tell me a time you watched or played an extreme sport

content.main_topic: Tell me a time you watched or played an extreme sport

sub_questions.question: Tell me a time you watched or played an extreme sport
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I would like to tell you about my trekking trip to Lao Than mountain in Lao Cai last year. This was the first time I tried trekking, which is a very challenging sport. I went with a group of friends and we had to walk for many hours to reach the top. The road was very steep and rocky, and I felt very tired because I had to carry a heavy backpack. There were moments when I wanted to stop, but my friends encouraged me to keep going. When we finally reached the peak at sunset, the view was amazing with many clouds below us. It was a difficult activity, but it helped me become stronger and more patient.

sub_questions.question: How do you feel when you play extreme sports?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I felt a mix of exhaustion and excitement. During the trek, my legs were very sore and I was breathing hard, but I also felt very proud of myself. When I conquered the mountain, I felt a great sense of achievement. It made me realize that I am much stronger than I thought.

sub_questions.question: Only adults are allowed to play extreme sports. What do you think about it?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I think this is a good rule for very dangerous sports. However, for trekking, I believe older children can join if they are healthy and have their parents with them. It is important for young people to experience nature and learn how to overcome difficulties, but safety must always be the first priority.

title: Tell me about a time you were with someone older or younger than you

content.main_topic: Tell me about a time you were with someone older or younger than you

sub_questions.question: Tell me about a time you were with someone older or younger than you
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I would like to tell you about the time I spent a whole weekend with my five-year-old nephew last month. My sister was busy, so she asked me to look after him. We went to the park, played with toy cars, and watched cartoons together. It was quite a long time since I last played like a child. At first, I found it a bit tiring because he had so much energy and kept asking many questions about everything he saw. However, we had a lot of fun together. I even taught him how to draw a simple house and a tree. Spending time with someone much younger made me forget about my stress and reminded me of my own childhood memories. It was a very happy and special weekend for both of us.

sub_questions.question: How do you feel in the situation?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I felt very relaxed and joyful. Even though children can be a bit noisy, their innocence makes me feel peaceful. I also felt a sense of responsibility because I had to take care of him and make sure he was safe. Overall, it was a very refreshing experience compared to my busy life with adults.

sub_questions.question: How do you think different generations can learn from each other?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I think young people can learn valuable life lessons and wisdom from the older generation. On the other hand, older people can learn about new technology and modern trends from the youth. This exchange of knowledge helps both sides understand each other better and narrows the generation gap.

title: Talk about a time when you asked a question

content.main_topic: Talk about a time when you asked a question

sub_questions.question: Talk about a time when you asked a question
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I remember a time last year during my English class at university. The teacher was explaining a very difficult grammar point about 'Conditional Sentences'. I didn't understand it at all, and I felt very confused. At first, I was a bit shy to speak because I was afraid my question might be silly. However, I realized that if I didn't ask, I wouldn't be able to finish my homework. So, I raised my hand and asked the teacher to give more examples. The teacher was very kind and explained it again slowly. My classmates also listened carefully, and some of them told me later that they had the same question. Asking that question helped me understand the lesson better and get a high score in the final exam.

sub_questions.question: Is it easy to ask a question?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: In my opinion, it depends on the situation. If you are with friends or family, it is very easy. But in a big class or at a meeting, it can be difficult because some people feel shy or afraid of being judged. However, I think we should always ask when we are confused because it is the best way to learn.

sub_questions.question: Some subjects are more difficult for many people. What do you think?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I think this is true. For example, many people find Math or Science very hard because they require a lot of logical thinking and formulas. Other people might find languages difficult because they need a good memory. Each person has a different strength, so some subjects will always be more challenging than others.

title: Tell me the last time you used the Internet?

content.main_topic: Tell me the last time you used the Internet?

sub_questions.question: Tell me the last time you used the Internet?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I used the Internet just a few minutes ago before I started this speaking test. I used my smartphone to check some English vocabulary and look for some tips for the Aptis exam. Also, this morning, I spent about thirty minutes using the Internet to read the news and check my emails. I usually use the Internet for many things in my daily life, such as watching videos on YouTube to learn cooking or chatting with my friends on Facebook. I think I use the Internet almost every hour because it is very convenient and it helps me find any information I need very quickly. Without the Internet, my study and my life would be much more difficult.

sub_questions.question: How do you feel when you use the Internet?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I feel very excited and connected when I use the Internet. It makes me feel like the world is very small because I can talk to people far away. However, sometimes I feel a bit overwhelmed because there is too much information, and I can spend too much time on social media without noticing it.

sub_questions.question: Some people say that the Internet has a bad impact on our lives. What do you think?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I think the Internet is like a tool; it can be good or bad depending on how we use it. If people use it too much, they might become lazy or have health problems. But if we use it for learning and working, it is very helpful. We just need to find a balance.

title: Describe a time you saw an impressive work of art

content.main_topic: Describe a time you saw an impressive work of art

sub_questions.question: Describe a time you saw an impressive work of art
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I would like to tell you about the time I saw a famous painting called 'The Starry Night' by Vincent van Gogh. I didn't see the original one, but I saw a very large and high-quality copy in an art gallery in Hanoi last year. The painting has many beautiful colors like deep blue and bright yellow. I was very impressed by the way the artist painted the stars and the moon; they looked like they were moving in the sky. I stood in front of it for a long time just to look at the details. Before that, I didn't know much about art, but this painting really caught my attention. It was the first time I realized that art could be so powerful and beautiful at the same time.

sub_questions.question: How did you feel?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I felt very calm and curious when I looked at the painting. The colors made me feel peaceful, but the shapes made me wonder about what the artist was thinking. It was a strange but wonderful feeling, and it made me want to learn more about the history of art and other famous painters.

sub_questions.question: Is it impossible to teach children to be creative? Do you agree/disagree?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I disagree with this idea. I believe children are naturally creative, but we can teach them how to develop it. By giving them paper, colors, and the freedom to draw what they want, we help them use their imagination. Teachers can guide them, but they shouldn't tell them exactly what to do.

title: Describe a time you went to an amusement park

content.main_topic: Describe a time you went to an amusement park

sub_questions.question: Describe a time you went to an amusement park
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I would like to tell you about my visit to Sun World Park in Da Nang two years ago. I went there with my family during our summer vacation. The park was huge with many different areas for games, food, and sightseeing. I remember being very excited when I first walked through the gate because there was upbeat music and colorful decorations everywhere. We spent the whole day trying different activities. My younger brother loved the gentle rides like the carousel, but I preferred the more exciting ones. We also had a great lunch at a buffet restaurant inside the park. We stayed until evening to see the beautiful lights and the fountain show. It was a tiring day because we walked a lot, but it was one of the happiest memories I have with my family.

sub_questions.question: How do you feel when going to these places?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I usually feel very energized and happy. These places help me forget about my stress from work or study. Even though I sometimes feel a bit scared of the fast rides, the atmosphere of everyone laughing and having fun makes me feel very positive and relaxed.

sub_questions.question: Rides at amusement parks are scary. Why do most people take part in these activities?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I think people like these rides because they want to feel a 'rush' of excitement. Even though it is scary, they know it is safe, so it is a good way to test their courage. After finishing a scary ride, people often feel very proud and excited, which is a great feeling.

title: Describe a time when you learned something new

content.main_topic: Describe a time when you learned something new

sub_questions.question: Describe a time when you learned something new
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I would like to tell you about the time I learned how to cook traditional Vietnamese food last summer. Before that, I only knew how to cook very simple things like fried eggs or instant noodles. I decided to learn because I wanted to surprise my mother on her birthday. I asked my grandmother to teach me how to make 'Phở' and spring rolls. It was quite difficult at first because there were many steps and ingredients. I remember spent hours in the kitchen, learning how to choose the best meat and spices. Finally, I successfully cooked a big dinner for my family. Everyone was very surprised and praised my food. It was a wonderful experience because I learned a new skill and made my family happy.

sub_questions.question: How did you feel when you learn something new?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I felt a mix of curiosity and excitement. At the beginning, I was a bit nervous because I was afraid of making mistakes. However, when I started to understand how to do it, I felt very interested and motivated. Finishing a task and learning something new always gives me a great sense of achievement.

sub_questions.question: Is it never too old to learn new things? Do you agree or disagree?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I totally agree with this opinion. Learning has no age limit. When older people learn new things, like how to use a smartphone or a new language, it keeps their minds active and healthy. It also helps them connect better with the younger generation and find more joy in life.

title: Describe a time when you visited someone

content.main_topic: Describe a time when you visited someone

sub_questions.question: Describe a time when you visited someone
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I would like to tell you about a time I visited my high school teacher at her house last November. It was Teachers' Day in Vietnam, so a group of my old classmates decided to come and see her. She lives in a small, cozy house with a beautiful garden. When we arrived, she was very surprised and happy. We sat in the living room, drank tea, and talked about our lives after graduation. I showed her some photos of my university and told her about my new friends. She also showed us her old photo albums. We stayed there for three hours and had a very good time together. It was a special visit because it helped us stay connected with our teacher even though we had finished school for a long time.

sub_questions.question: What do you think about having unexpected visitors?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: In my opinion, having unexpected visitors is a mix of joy and stress. On the one hand, I feel very happy to see my friends or relatives because it shows they care about me. We can talk and have fun together. On the other hand, it can be inconvenient. If my house is messy or I don't have enough food, I feel a bit embarrassed. I prefer it when people call me before they come so I can prepare everything better.

sub_questions.question: Some people like to live in small communities, while others like to live in big cities. What is your opinion?​
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: In my opinion, both places have their own advantages. Living in a small community is peaceful and everyone knows each other, which feels very safe. However, I prefer living in a big city because there are more job opportunities, better hospitals, and more places for entertainment. It depends on what kind of lifestyle you like.

title: Tell me about a time when you tried hard to achieve something

content.main_topic: Tell me about a time when you tried hard to achieve something

sub_questions.question: Tell me about a time when you tried hard to achieve something
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I would like to tell you about the time I tried to learn how to swim last summer. Before that, I was very afraid of water and I couldn't even put my face in the pool. My goal was to swim 25 meters without stopping. I went to the swimming pool three times a week and practiced with a coach. At first, it was very difficult and I swallowed a lot of water, which made me want to give up. However, I kept practicing every day and watched many tutorial videos on YouTube. After two months of hard work, I finally achieved my goal. I remember the day I reached the other side of the pool, I was so happy. It was a small success but it required a lot of effort from me.

sub_questions.question: How did you feel?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I felt extremely proud and relieved. Overcoming a fear is a great feeling, and it made me feel more confident in myself. I realized that if I try hard enough and don't give up, I can learn anything, even things that used to scare me.

sub_questions.question: How can people be encouraged to achieve hard things?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I think we can encourage people by giving them praise and small rewards. When people see that their hard work is recognized, they will have more energy to continue. Also, showing them successful stories of others can inspire them to try harder.

title: Tell me a time when you were in a hurry

content.main_topic: Tell me a time when you were in a hurry

sub_questions.question: Tell me a time when you were in a hurry
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I remember a time last month when I woke up late for an important job interview. My alarm clock didn't go off, and I only had twenty minutes to get ready and leave the house. I was in a big hurry, so I skipped breakfast and ran to the bus stop as fast as I could. Unfortunately, the bus was late because of heavy traffic in the city center. I decided to take a motorbike taxi instead to save time. I remember checking my watch every minute and feeling very worried that I would miss the chance to get the job. Finally, I arrived at the office just one minute before the interview started. It was a very stressful morning that I will never forget.

sub_questions.question: How did you feel?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I felt extremely nervous and panicked. My heart was beating very fast, and I couldn't think clearly because I was so focused on the time. After I arrived and realized I wasn't late, I felt a huge sense of relief, but my body was still shaking from the rush. It was an unpleasant feeling.

sub_questions.question: Modern life makes us busier and more rushed. What do you think?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: Yes, I definitely agree. With smartphones and the internet, we are always connected to work and study. There is more competition now, so people have to work harder and faster to succeed. This makes everyone feel more rushed and they have less time to relax with their family.

title: Tell me a time when you received a good news

content.main_topic: Tell me a time when you received a good news

sub_questions.question: Tell me a time when you received a good news
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I remember a very happy day last year when I received an email saying that I won a scholarship to study abroad. At that time, I was sitting in a cafe with my friends, and I suddenly checked my phone. I was so surprised that I shouted out loud, and all my bạn bè were looking at me. I had worked very hard for six months to prepare my application and practice for the interview. I didn't tell many people because I was afraid of failing. This news was very important to me because studying in a different country was my biggest dream since I was a child. Right after that, I called my parents to tell them, and my mother even cried because she was so happy for me.

sub_questions.question: How did you feel?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I felt a mix of extreme joy and relief. All the stress and hard work from the previous months suddenly disappeared. I felt like I was walking on air and couldn't stop smiling for the whole day. It gave me a lot of confidence and excitement for my future journey.

sub_questions.question: Why do people like to celebrate good news?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I think people like to celebrate good news because it is a way to share happiness with family and friends. Celebrating helps us remember the special moments and makes our relationships stronger. Also, it is a great reward after a long time of hard work, which motivates us to keep going.

title: Tell me about a time when you were successful in a challenging situation?

content.main_topic: Tell me about a time when you were successful in a challenging situation?

sub_questions.question: Tell me about a time when you were successful in a challenging situation
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I would like to tell you about the time I had to give a presentation in front of 100 people at my university last year. To be honest, I was very shy and always felt scared of public speaking. My challenge was to talk about a complicated topic in English for 15 minutes. To prepare, I practiced every night in front of the mirror and recorded my voice to check my pronunciation. I also asked my friends to listen and give me feedback. On the day of the presentation, my heart was beating very fast, but I remembered all my practice and stayed calm. In the end, I finished it successfully and everyone clapped for me. It was a big success for me because I overcame my biggest fear.

sub_questions.question: How do you feel when you are given a challenge?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: Initially, I often feel a bit nervous and worried because I am afraid of failing. However, after a few minutes, I feel excited because a challenge is an opportunity to learn something new. I like the feeling of trying my best to solve a problem and becoming more confident afterward.

sub_questions.question: What can help people face the challenges of daily life?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I think a positive mindset is the most important thing. If we stay optimistic, we can find solutions more easily. Also, having support from family and friends is very helpful. They can give us good advice and encourage us when we feel tired or sad.

title: Tell about a time when you were supported by others

content.main_topic: Tell about a time when you were supported by others

sub_questions.question: Tell about a time when you were supported by others
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I remember a time last year when I was preparing for a very important group presentation at my university. I was the leader, but suddenly I got a bad flu and had to stay in bed for three days. I was very worried because the deadline was coming soon. However, my team members were very kind. They told me not to worry and divided my work among themselves. One friend collected the data, and another finished the PowerPoint slides for me. They even came to my house to bring me some hot soup and medicine. Thanks to their great support, our group finished the project on time and got an A. It was a time that I realized how important good friends and teammates are.

sub_questions.question: How did you feel?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I felt extremely touched and grateful for their help. At first, I felt stressed and guilty because I couldn't do my job, but their kindness made me feel much better. I felt lucky to have such supportive friends who were willing to help me during a difficult time.

sub_questions.question: What are ways to motivate others to cooperate?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I think the best way is to have clear communication. We should listen to everyone's ideas and respect them. Also, giving small rewards or saying 'thank you' can make people feel happy and more willing to work together. When everyone knows their role, they will cooperate better.

title: Tell me about a time when you were busy

content.main_topic: Tell me about a time when you were busy

sub_questions.question: Tell me about a time when you were busy
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I remember a very busy time last month when I had to prepare for my final exams at university. At the same time, I also had a part-time job at a coffee shop. Every day, I woke up at 6 a.m. to study, then I went to classes until noon. In the afternoon, I worked for five hours, and in the evening, I went back home to finish my assignments. I remember having very little time to sleep or eat properly. I couldn't even meet my friends or watch my favorite movies. It was a very difficult two weeks because everything happened at the same time. However, I tried my best to manage my schedule, and finally, I passed all my exams with good grades.

sub_questions.question: How do you feel when you are very busy?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: When I am very busy, I usually feel quite stressed and tired. Sometimes, I feel overwhelmed because I have too many things to do in a short time. However, I also feel productive and active. If I manage to finish all my tasks, I feel a great sense of satisfaction and pride.

sub_questions.question: If people work less, do you think their lives will be better?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: Yes, I think so. If people work less, they will have more time for their family and hobbies. This helps them reduce stress and stay healthy. However, they also need enough money to live, so the most important thing is to have a good balance between work and life.

title: Tell me about a time you had to do something but you didn’t want

content.main_topic: Tell me about a time you had to do something but you didn’t want

sub_questions.question: Tell me about a time you had to do something but you didn’t want to
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I remember a time last year when I had to help my parents clean the whole house before the Lunar New Year. To be honest, I really didn't want to do it because it was my winter break and I just wanted to sleep or play video games. The house was very big and we had to clean every corner, from the kitchen to the garden. My parents were very busy, so I couldn't say no. I spent two full days scrubbing the floors and moving heavy furniture. It was very tiring and boring at first, and I felt a bit annoyed because my friends were out having fun. However, I saw how tired my parents were, so I tried my best to finish everything.

sub_questions.question: How did you feel after it?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: After finishing everything, I felt surprisingly good. When I saw the house looking clean and beautiful for Tet, I felt very proud and happy. My parents also thanked me and were very pleased. I realized that doing something I didn't like could bring a good result for my family, and the feeling of finishing a hard task was very satisfying.

sub_questions.question: How can people motivate themselves to do things they don't like?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I think people can motivate themselves by thinking about the result. If you focus on the benefits after you finish, you will feel more energy. Also, you can give yourself a small reward, like a favorite snack or a movie, after completing the task. Breaking the work into small parts also makes it easier to start.

title: Tell me about a time you tried hard to achieve your goal

content.main_topic: Tell me about a time you tried hard to achieve your goal

sub_questions.question: Tell me about a time when you tried hard to achieve something
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I would like to tell you about the time I studied for my university entrance exam two years ago. My goal was to get into a top university in Hanoi, which was very difficult. I remember I had to wake up at 5 a.m. every day and study until late at night. I didn't go out with my friends or watch movies for three months. I spent all my time doing exercises and reading textbooks. There were times when I felt very tired and wanted to give up, but I kept thinking about my future and my parents. Finally, when I received the results, I was so happy because I passed with high scores. It was a time that I worked the hardest in my life.

sub_questions.question: How did you feel about it?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I felt extremely relieved and proud of myself. The moment I saw my name on the list, all my tiredness disappeared. I realized that if I work hard and stay focused, I can overcome any challenge. It gave me more confidence to face other goals in my life.

sub_questions.question: What do people need to do to achieve their goals?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: In my opinion, people need two things: a clear plan and discipline. First, they should break their big goal into small steps so it is easier to follow. Second, they must stay patient and never give up when they face difficulties. Success doesn't come overnight.

title: Tell me a time you read a good book

content.main_topic: Tell me a time you read a good book

sub_questions.question: Tell me a time you read a good book
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I would like to tell you about a very famous Vietnamese book called 'Give Me a Ticket to Childhood' by Nguyen Nhat Anh. I read it last year during my summer holiday. The book is about the memories of four children and their funny stories in a small village. I remember sitting on my balcony and laughing a lot because the characters were so naughty and smart. Before that, I only read textbooks for my exams, but this book was different. It made me remember my own childhood with my friends. The language is very simple but very beautiful. I finished the book in just one afternoon because I couldn't stop reading. It is definitely a book that every Vietnamese student should read at least once.

sub_questions.question: How did you feel?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I felt very happy and a bit nostalgic after reading it. It made me feel like I was a child again, playing outside without any worries or stress. The book helped me relax after a busy school year and reminded me to appreciate the simple things in my life.

sub_questions.question: Do people prefer watching TV to reading books? What do you think about this?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I think it is true for many people because watching TV is easier and more entertaining. However, I still believe reading is better because it helps us imagine the story in our own way. A book like Nguyen Nhat Anh's can touch our hearts much more than a movie on TV.

title: Tell me a time you received a gift

content.main_topic: Tell me a time you received a gift

sub_questions.question: Tell me about a time you received a gift
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I would like to tell you about a special gift I received on my 18th birthday. It was a beautiful wristwatch from my parents. I remember that morning, my father called me to the living room and gave me a small, elegant box. When I opened it, I was very surprised because I had wanted a watch for a long time but never told them. It has a silver strap and a classic white face. My parents said that they bought it for me to help me manage my time better when I started university. This gift is very important to me not because of its price, but because it shows how much my parents care about my future and my studies.

sub_questions.question: How did you feel about this gift?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I felt extremely touched and grateful when I received the watch. It was more than just a tool to tell time; it was a symbol of my parents' love and support. Every time I wear it, I feel more confident and motivated to work harder. It truly made my birthday unforgettable.

sub_questions.question: Do you prefer handmade gifts or gifts bought in store?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: To be honest, I prefer handmade gifts. Even though store-bought gifts are often more modern and expensive, handmade gifts are unique and full of emotion. When someone spends time making something for you, it shows that they really value your relationship. To me, the effort is the most important part of a gift.

title: Talk about a time you bought an expensive thing

content.main_topic: Talk about a time you bought an expensive thing

sub_questions.question: Talk about a time you bought an expensive thing
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I remember a time last year when I bought a new laptop for my studies. It was a MacBook and it was very expensive, about 30 million VND. At first, I was very hesitant because I had to save my pocket money for a long time. I also asked my parents for some help. I went to the store with my best friend, and when I saw the laptop, I liked it immediately. It looks very modern and works very fast. Before that, I used a very old computer that was often broken. Buying this laptop was a big decision for me, but I think it was a good investment because I use it every day for my homework and online classes.

sub_questions.question: How did you feel?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: When I first held the laptop, I felt extremely happy and excited. However, I also felt a little bit worried because I had spent a lot of money. But after using it for a week, those worries disappeared. I felt proud of myself because I worked hard and saved money to buy something high-quality that I really needed.

sub_questions.question: Should people buy expensive things? Why?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I think it depends on the situation. If an expensive thing has good quality and we use it for a long time, we should buy it. For example, a good phone or a laptop is worth the money. However, people should not buy expensive things just to show off if they don't have enough money. We should always spend money wisely.

title: Tell me a time you were surrounded by nature

content.main_topic: Tell me a time you were surrounded by nature

sub_questions.question: Tell me a time you were surrounded by nature
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I would like to tell you about my trip to Da Lat last summer. Da Lat is a beautiful city with many mountains, pine forests, and colorful flowers. I remember one morning, I woke up early and went to a small lake called Tuyen Lam Lake. At that time, everything was very quiet and covered in fog. I was surrounded by tall trees and the sound of birds singing. There were no cars or loud noises, just the fresh air and the beauty of nature. I spent three hours walking around the lake and taking many photos. It was the first time I felt so close to nature, away from the busy life in the city. It was truly a wonderful experience that I will never forget.

sub_questions.question: How did you feel?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I felt extremely relaxed and peaceful at that moment. All my stress from work and study seemed to disappear. Being in nature made me feel energized and fresh. I realized that nature is very important for our mental health, and we should spend more time outdoors to feel better.

sub_questions.question: How can people be encouraged to protect and preserve nature?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I think there are several ways to encourage people to protect nature. First, education is key. Schools should teach children about the importance of trees and animals from a young age. Second, the government should use social media to show the beauty of nature and the problems of pollution. When people see beautiful landscapes, they will want to protect them. Finally, we can encourage people by giving rewards, such as giving discounts to those who use reusable bags or recycle trash. Small actions can lead to big changes.

title: Have you talked to older or younger people?

content.main_topic: Have you talked to older or younger people?

sub_questions.question: Have you talked to older or younger people? What did you say?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: Yes, I talk to both older and younger people almost every day. For example, every evening, I spend time talking to my grandfather. We usually talk about his life in the past and how Vietnam has changed over the years. He often tells me stories about the war and his old friends. On the other hand, I also talk to my younger cousin, who is only ten years old. With him, I usually talk about his school, his favorite video games, or the cartoons he likes. Talking to older people helps me learn about history, while talking to children makes me feel young and happy. I think it is very important to communicate with different generations to understand life better.

sub_questions.question: How do you feel when you talk to them?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: When I talk to older people, I feel very respectful and curious because they have so much experience. However, when I talk to younger people, I feel relaxed and energized. Sometimes it can be a bit difficult to understand their teen slang, but overall, I find these conversations very interesting and meaningful.

sub_questions.question: When you talk to them, what do you get?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: Ultimately, these interactions provide me with a more well-rounded perspective on life. I gain invaluable wisdom and a long-term outlook from the elderly, while the youth provide me with fresh energy and a better understanding of future trends. This 'knowledge exchange' is essential for personal growth and helps bridge the gap between different age groups in our community.

title: Have you faced a choice yet?

content.main_topic: Have you faced a choice yet?

sub_questions.question: Have you faced a choice yet? If so, can you tell me?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: Yes, I have faced a very important choice in my life. Two years ago, after finishing high school, I had to choose my major at university. At that time, my parents wanted me to study Accounting because they thought it was a stable job. However, I really loved Graphic Design because I like drawing and creating things. I felt very confused and spent many nights thinking about it. Finally, I decided to follow my passion and chose Graphic Design. My parents were a bit worried at first, but now they are happy because they see that I am doing very well and enjoying my studies. I think it was the most difficult but best decision I have ever made.

sub_questions.question: How did you feel?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: At that time, I felt very stressed and a little bit scared. I was afraid that if I made the wrong choice, I would regret it in the future. I also felt pressure because I didn't want to make my parents sad. However, after making the final decision, I felt much more relieved and excited to start my new journey.

sub_questions.question: Faced with a choice, what do you need to prepare?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I think we need to prepare two things. First, we should collect information about the choices to understand them clearly. Second, we should talk to people we trust, like parents or teachers, to get advice. Having a clear plan and a strong mind will help us make a better choice.

title: Tell me about a time you helped someone.

content.main_topic: Tell me about a time you helped someone.

sub_questions.question: Tell me about a time you helped someone.
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I’d like to share an experience from last rainy season in Saigon. I was driving home from work when I encountered an elderly man whose motorbike had broken down in the middle of a heavy downpour. Most people were rushing to find shelter, but I decided to pull over and assist him. His engine was flooded due to the high water levels on the street, which is a common issue here. I helped him push his bike to a nearby repair shop and waited with him until the mechanic started working on it. During that time, he shared stories about his family and expressed how grateful he was. Even though I got completely soaked and arrived home late, the sense of fulfillment I gained from helping him was absolutely worth it.

sub_questions.question: How did you feel?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: Initially, I felt a bit hesitant because of the heavy rain, but that was quickly replaced by a deep sense of empathy. Witnessing his relief and gratitude made me feel incredibly warm-hearted. It reminded me that small acts of kindness can have a significant impact on someone's day, especially when they are in a vulnerable situation.

sub_questions.question: How to encourage people to help others?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: To foster a helpful community, I believe we should focus on two main areas: recognition and education. Primarily, highlighting everyday acts of kindness in the media can create a 'pay it forward' effect, inspiring others to take action. Furthermore, integrating community service into the school curriculum helps students develop empathy and a sense of responsibility from an early age. In my opinion, when people realize that their small contributions can lead to significant social changes, they will be much more inclined to lend a helping hand.

title: Tell me about a time when you couldn’t buy the thing that you want?

content.main_topic: Tell me about a time when you couldn’t buy the thing that you want?

sub_questions.question: Tell me about a time when you couldn’t buy the thing that you want?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I’d like to share an experience from my university years when I desperately wanted a high-end laptop for my graphic design projects. Back then, the price of the laptop was astronomical compared to my part-time salary. I vividly remember walking into the store in Ho Chi Minh City, looking at the device, but realizing I simply couldn't afford it. It was quite a frustrating situation because that tool was essential for my career development. Looking back, that moment was a turning point for me. Instead of feeling sorry for myself, it motivated me to work harder and manage my finances more strictly. Eventually, when I finally saved enough to purchase it a year later, the sense of achievement was much more rewarding than the product itself.

sub_questions.question: How did you feel that time?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: To be honest, I felt very disappointed and a bit sad at that moment. It was difficult to see my friends having the things they liked while I had to wait. I also felt a little embarrassed when I couldn't buy it. However, after a few days, I felt more determined. I told myself that I would work harder to earn money. Looking back, those feelings helped me to understand the value of money and be more patient in life.

sub_questions.question: Material possession alone cannot make people happy. Do you agree/disagree?
sub_questions.sampleAnswer: I totally agree with this statement. In my opinion, money and expensive things can buy comfort, but they cannot buy true happiness. For example, you can buy a big house, but you cannot buy a happy family. In Vietnam, many people work very hard to earn money, but they feel stressed and lonely. I believe that happiness comes from simple things like spending time with friends, having good health, and helping others. Material things are important, but they are not everything in life.

content.prompt: Tell me a painting or a photo that you like
content.sampleAnswer: I like the photo of my family, which was taken 10 years ago. It is beautiful and important to me. It shows my family on the beach. I like this photo because it reminds me of my family.

part_data.instruction: You are speaking to fellow members of the Art Club in a group chat. Respond to them in full sentences (30-40 words per answer).

questions.question: I kept a painting for a long time. Tell me a thing that you have had for a long time.
questions.sampleAnswer: I’ve had my old sketchbook for years. It holds a lot of memories, sketches from different stages of my life, and always reminds me of how much my art has evolved over time.

questions.question: I would like to learn painting, but I have not found an effective way. Should I take a course at my local college? Please, give me some advice.
questions.sampleAnswer: If you're serious about learning painting, taking a course at your local college could be a great idea. Structured lessons with an experienced instructor can really boost your skills and provide useful feedback.

questions.question: Street art – where people paint on the building – is becoming popular. However, some people criticize that it is bad. What is your opinion?
questions.sampleAnswer: I think street art can be a beautiful form of expression, but it also depends on the context and location. It’s important to respect the space, but when done well, it can really enhance a community's atmosphere.

title: Art Club - Part 4
instruction: You are a member of an Art Club. You received this email from the club.

part_data.instruction: You are a member of an Art Club. You received this email from the club.

email.body:
Dear all members,

The Art Club is organising a talk to the public to attract more attention. We are going to invite an artist to give a talk to the members. As a member of our club, could you give us an artist to join our talk and what topic should they share to gain more attention? We would like to have more young and elderly members.

Bests,
Club Manager.

tasks.instruction: Write an email to your friend - also a member of the club. (50 words)
tasks.sampleAnswer:
Hi Jane,

It’s me, Mary. How’s it going? Our club is organizing a talk to the public to attract more attention. I was so excited to hear that. I think we should invite Mr. David, a famous art in our city. He can share about the topic “Art for everyone”. What do you think? Let’s talk about it later.

Love,
Mary

tasks.instruction: Write an email to the president of the club (about 120-150 words). Tell them your thoughts about this and what you would like to do.
tasks.sampleAnswer:
Dear Manager,

My name is Mary. I have been an active member of the club for the last 6 months. I am writing this email regarding the plan mentioned in the latest announcement from our club.
As stated in the email, our club is planning to organize a talk to the public. Honestly, I was so excited to hear that news because we can attract more members. I think we should invite a famous artist. I highly recommend Mr. David, a famous artist in our country. He is handsome and friendly. Regarding the topic of the talk, he can talk about the topic “Art for Everyone”. I think that it is suitable for young and old people. 

Hopefully, my ideas will be useful for our club. I am looking forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Mary Connor
